title: Thunderstorm
hook: 晴天野餐时突然打雷下雨，屋顶漏水，猪爸爸拿桶接水，雨停后花园全是泥坑。

cells.q: What is the weather like at the start?
cells.a: It is a lovely, sunny day for a picnic.
cells.cn: 一开始是晴朗的好天气，正适合野餐。

cells.q: What are Peppa and George playing?
cells.a: They are having a picnic with Teddy and Mr. Dinosaur.
cells.cn: 他们在和泰迪、恐龙先生一起野餐。

cells.a: She heard a loud bang sound in the sky.
cells.cn: 她听到天上“砰”的一声巨响。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig rescue from the garden?
cells.a: He rescued Teddy and Mr. Dinosaur from the rain.
cells.cn: 他把泰迪和恐龙先生从雨里救了回来。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig say about Teddy?
cells.a: He said, “There you are, Teddy! All dry!”
cells.cn: 他说：“你在这儿呀，泰迪！一点都没湿！”

cells.a: The rain came into the house and the floor got wet.
cells.cn: 雨漏进了屋里，地板都湿了。

cells.q: What is Daddy Pig doing with the bucket?
cells.a: He is using a bucket to catch the drips from the roof.
cells.cn: 他用桶接屋顶滴下来的水。

cells.q: How can they tell the storm is far away?
cells.a: The higher they can count, the further away the storm is.
cells.cn: 数得越高，说明雷雨离得越远。

cells.q: What did the thunderstorm leave in the garden?
cells.a: It filled the garden with muddy puddles to jump in.
cells.cn: 它让花园里积满了可以跳的泥坑。

helper.keywords: sunny, picnic, bang, rain, bucket, puddle
helper.actions: eat, hear, rescue, catch, count, jump

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Thunderstorm”.
ending: In the end, the garden is full of muddy puddles. My favourite part is ______.
